## Summary

Describe the change and the student or teacher need it addresses.

## Screenshots

For visible changes, include the previous and updated views at desktop and narrow sizes.

## Verification

- [ ] Type checking
- [ ] Game logic self-check
- [ ] Asset verification, if assets changed
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Browser flow, if screens or interactions changed

Checks run:

## Curriculum and attribution

- [ ] Historical facts and alternate-history outcomes remain clearly separated.
- [ ] Curriculum coverage and sources are updated when needed.
- [ ] Third-party assets and licenses are recorded when needed.

## Accessibility and saves

- [ ] Interface text uses sentence case or title case.
- [ ] Text and controls fit at the tested window sizes.
- [ ] Keyboard, scrolling, and reduced-motion behavior remain usable.
- [ ] Save or profile data changes are documented.
